item.text:
The Cold Climate Air-Source Heat Pump is **Upgrade 04** (measure ID **hvac_004**) in ResStock 2025 Release 1. See the [release README](https://oedi-data-lake.s3.amazonaws.com/nrel-pds-building-stock/end-use-load-profiles-for-us-building-stock/2025/resstock_amy2018_release_1/README_resstock_20251.pdf).

It is documented in **[ResStock Measure Documentation: Cold Climate Air-Source Heat Pump](https://doi.org/10.2172/3365374)** by Philip White and Andrew Parker (2026), report **NLR/TP-5500-96413**.
